documents.text: The R ChickWeight dataset describes an experiment on early growth under four protein diets. Body weight is recorded in grams; Time is days since birth; Chick is a unique chick identifier; Diet identifies the experimental diet. Weights were measured at birth and every second day until day 20, and also at day 21. The complete curated table has 578 observations. The R source cites Crowder and Hand (1990), Example 5.3, pages 74–78, and Hand and Crowder (1996), Table A.2, page 172. Ordered factor labels identify chicks; factor ordering groups diets and orders final weights.
documents.title: R documentation of early chick growth observations

documents.text: R datasets Puromycin documents substrate concentration in ppm and instantaneous reaction rate in counts/min/min. It says counts per minute of radioactive product were measured as a function of substrate concentration, then initial reaction velocity was calculated. The experiment was conducted once with enzyme treated with Puromycin and once untreated. There are 23 rows. Source: Treloar (1974), as reproduced in Bates and Watts (1988), AppendixA 1.3; curated R source transcription.

documents.text: The R BOD dataset contains six observations of biochemical oxygen demand versus time in an evaluation of water quality. Time is the measurement time in days; demand is biochemical oxygen demand in mg/l. The R source attributes the data to Marske (1967), reproduced in Bates and Watts (1988), Appendix A1.4, page 270. The documentation illustrates fitting an asymptotic first-order curve to the recorded values.

documents.text: The R datasets manual describes the sleep data as the effect of two soporific drugs: increase in hours of sleep compared with control on 10 patients. The column extra is the increase in hours; group identifies the drug and ID identifies the patient. The manual explicitly states that the group name may be misleading: these are measurements on 10 persons, not separate groups. The data have 20 observations. The source citations are Cushny and Peebles (1905) and Student (1908). This packet transcribes the public R dataset and its documentation.
documents.title: R datasets documentation of the historical sleep study
